audit.whatIsWrong: Difficulty text was built around Distortion as the whole threat and used male pronouns for LeBlanc.
audit.why: Distortion is a 600-range dash on 15s at rank 1; the ability that actually beats you is Ethereal Chains at 925 range, which roots after 1.5s and cancels Breath of Light and Astral Flight.
audit.corrected: 8/10 stands, but the lane is fought at 925 against Chains, not at 600 against the dash.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart disagreed across layers on the last two rows: phases[5].side='LeBlanc' and phases[6].side='Skill' against win[5]=win[6]='Aurelion Sol'.
audit.why: packet.levelChart reads LeBlanc for five rows then Aurelion Sol twice, matching the content layer.
audit.corrected: Full layer set to Aurelion Sol on both rows as one atomic group.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing stated that Ethereal Chains cancels your channels, and Mimic was described as 'resetting Sigil' rather than repeating a basic spell.
audit.why: Your Q and W are both flagged 'channel: interruptible — any CC cancels it'; Chains is hardCC at 925 range. Mimic casts a mimicked version of one of her basic spells, 45/35/25s.
audit.corrected: Written into breakdown.cooldowns, tradeBad, dontsFull[0].d, spikes[1] and mid.

audit.whatIsWrong: content.mid told the player to use 'Voidlink defensively' and wants.you[1] referenced 'both Distortion charges'. Neither exists: Aurelion Sol has no Voidlink, and Distortion is a single dash with a 4-second return, not a charge system. wants.foe[0] also called Sigil of Malice a W.
audit.why: Owner kit is Breath of Light / Astral Flight / Singularity / Falling Star. Sigil of Malice is Q; Distortion is W.
audit.corrected: All three replaced with real abilities and slots.

audit.whatIsWrong: The cooldown section gave no numbers and no sequencing.
audit.why: Distortion 15/13.75/12.5/11.25/10s, Chains 14 down to 11s, Sigil 6s flat, Mimic 45/35/25s.
audit.corrected: Concrete: after the Distortion return she has roughly ten seconds with no escape, and that is your step-up.

edits.before: - LeBlanc Distortion: matchup-defining — Dash with a four-second return window — punish the return spot, and remember she is broke after it. It governs your forward steps. - W Astral Flight spent on poke is a death you scheduled. - Hold the R for the fight that decides something.
edits.after: - Distortion: 600-range dash with a 4s return window, 15s at rank 1 — after the return she has no escape for ten seconds, and that is your step-up. - Ethereal Chains reaches 925 and roots at 1.5s: it is what cancels your channel. - Mimic is 45s at rank 1.

edits.before: Ahead, compound it: shove with E executes, burn LeBlanc on every W rotation, and group early — your beam turns small mid-game leads into unanswerable objective control.
edits.after: Ahead, punish her return: E-execute the back line, and every time she Distortions in and back, that is a ten-second window where she cannot escape your beam.

edits.before: If LeBlanc opens the score, reset expectations and respect Distortion doubly. After a second, your job description changes — farm with E executes and stay relevant through the stardust curve.
edits.after: If LeBlanc opens the score, treat every Sigil mark as a kill threat and never channel with one on you. After a second kill, farm the back line with Singularity and bank Stardust until the first item lands.

edits.before: Carry by scaling honestly — every stardust stack is permanent, and the 30-minute version of you wins fights your laning self cannot imagine.
edits.after: Carry by outlasting her burst: LeBlanc has nothing once Distortion and Mimic are spent, and every Stardust stack you bank is permanent.

edits.before: Levels 1-2 are dangerous because LeBlanc's ranged Sigil poke chips you down safely while your stars aren't stacked enough to threaten her back, and by levels 3-5 her full Q-W-E combo threatens a near-instant kill any time you're caught out of position, so passive farming behind minions is mandatory.
edits.after: Levels 1-2 are dangerous because Sigil of Malice reaches 700 on a 6s cooldown and chips you for free while your beam has no Stardust behind it, and by levels 3-5 the Chains-Distortion-Sigil chain threatens a near-instant kill any time you are caught channelling out of position, so farm from behind the wave.

edits.before: Level 6 is by far her scariest spike since her ultimate re-triggers Sigil, letting her chain two full burst rotations in a single engage; you have no way to survive this combo without flashing or using Voidlink defensively, so play with extreme caution and never contest the LeBlanc side of the map alone at this level.
edits.after: Level 6 is her scariest spike: Mimic repeats a basic spell on a 45s cooldown, so a second Sigil detonation lands inside the same engage; your answers are Flash, Astral Flight held in reserve, or simply not being inside 925 when Chains is up. Never contest her side of the map alone at this level.

edits.before: Your first item closes some of the burst gap but she can still threaten a full kill combo if you misplay positioning, so keep playing safe until your stars are fully stacked and your ultimate is online, at which point your sustained range damage and global map threat finally outclass her burst-only kit that has nothing left once her combo is on cooldown.
edits.after: Your first item closes some of the burst gap but she still threatens a full kill combo the moment a Sigil lands, so keep playing spacing until Stardust is banked and The Skies Descend is online, at which point your sustained beam damage and map threat outclass a kit that has nothing left in the ten seconds after Distortion returns.

edits.before: LeBlanc's Sigil-chain burst combo (Q-W-E) one-shots or near-one-shots you the moment she has all three abilities online at 3, and your stars simply aren't threatening enough yet to punish her dive-and-reset pattern.
edits.after: LeBlanc's combo comes together at 3: Sigil of Malice marks, Distortion closes 600, Ethereal Chains roots at 1.5s, and any of them detonates the mark. Your beam has no Stardust behind it yet and cannot punish the return.

edits.before: Her ultimate resets Sigil for a second burst combo, meaning she can chain two full damage rotations in one engage, which is the scariest all-in window in the entire matchup for you.

edits.after: With Stardust banked and The Skies Descend online, your sustained beam and its range outclass a kit that spends everything in one rotation and has ten empty seconds after Distortion returns.
